Great Tech In Search Of Profits

AJ Cortese, Laila Khawaja

Gavekal Technologies: Briefing | 5 Oct 2026

Our 2026 China Trip found that China’s tech ecosystem is getting stronger. But most companies find themselves squeezed between domestic hyper-competition and rising geopolitical pressure.On September 6-11, Gavekal Technologies held its inaugural China Tech Trip with 19 institutional-investor clients. Through a dozen site visits and in-depth conversations with senior executives, we examined China’s semiconductor, AI, new energy, robotics and biotechnology industries. This week’s China Tech Brief explores some of the key findings. (For takeaways on semiconductors and AI, see GavekalTech On The Ground: 2026 China Tech Trip Takeaways).
